acceptance: Free disk is above the floor with headroom; stale merged worktrees are removed under an owner-approved rule; make pr-preflight runs without an override.
description: On 2026-11-01 the Mac had about 40 GiB free against the 50 GiB BENCHBOX_HEAVY_MIN_FREE_DISK_GIB floor, so make pr-preflight refused heavy work (exit 76). Three PRs ran preflight once with the floor lowered to 35, and #3899 merged without a clean preflight exit. The host has about 256 linked worktrees and a 31 GiB uv cache; uv cache prune was blocked by running uv processes. Owner-approved cleanup of merged-branch worktrees and caches is needed.
